passage.text: Camping has become popular among families in Japan. Parents take their children to campsites near the sea or in the mountains, and in this way, they give them a chance to enjoy nature. Many campsites now rent tents and cooking tools, so even beginners can join easily.

questions.prompt: Please look at the passage. According to the passage, how do parents give their children a chance to enjoy nature?
questions.modelAnswer: By taking them to campsites near the sea or in the mountains.

questions.modelAnswer: A man is putting up a tent. A woman is cooking on a grill. A girl is swimming in the sea. A boy is collecting firewood. An older man is fishing.

questions.prompt: Do you think it is important for children to spend time in nature?

yes.modelAnswer: Children learn things outside that they cannot learn from books. It is also good for their health.

no.modelAnswer: There are many things children need to study. Nature is not the only way to learn.

questions.prompt: These days, many people travel by train on weekends. Do you often travel by train?

yes.modelAnswer: I take the train to Osaka with my friends. We go shopping there.

no.modelAnswer: My family usually goes by car. There are not many trains near my house.
